# Document formats

Layer: framework core.

The [documentation standard](../standards/documentation.md#file-lifecycle) owns when each type is created, updated and retired. These formats shape real content. Leave out an optional section that does not apply, with a short reason; do not create empty scaffolding. A format does not establish approval. Relative links inside a format are written for the file's destination, so `common.md` in the role format and `reference.md` in the capability format resolve once the file is copied into place.

- [Capability](capability.md)
- [Requirements](requirements.md)
- [Implementation reference](implementation-reference.md)
- [History index](history.md)
- [Change plan](change-plan.md)
- [Build plan and checkpoint](build-plan.md)
- [Compact delivery record](compact-change.md)
- [Planning notes](planning-notes.md)
- [Decision](decision.md)
- [Role brief](agent.md)
- [Workflow](workflow.md)
